description: Active Media is a spin-off company of ClubCom, Inc., the leading private music television network for the fitness industry. The principal shareholders of Active Media founded ClubCom in January of 2000, and completed a strategic sale of ClubCom to Amer Group, PLC in January 2004. As part of the transaction, Active Media retained all advertising and promotional rights over the ClubCom network.
Aethon is a leader in healthcare Supply Chain Logistics and Workflow Solutions.
long_description: Aethon provides a broad range of departmental and hospital-wde applications that automate the movement of goods (such as medications, supplies, meals, equipment, etc.), improve asset utlization, and ensure regulatory compliance. Aethon delivers its solutions through a proprietary autonomous mobile robot, the TUG.

description: Amplifinity provides marketers with a turnkey SAAS based solution to harnesses the power of advocacy that is easy to implement and uncomplicated to manage.
long_description: Amplifinity’s system has automated referral best practices and makes it easy for marketers to create compliant, effective, and measurable referral channels that drive significant incremental revenue. Amplifinity’s foundation is built on sales best practices. The company was founded the belief that the best business was business that came from a current customer telling a salesperson about people they knew who needed your product or service. Combined with our socially connected world, Amplifinity founders believed there was incredible potential to take the concept of referrals and scale it digitally to create a consistent channel for customer acquisition and demand generation.

description: Autobooks is the first fully integrated payments & accounting platform for business, delivered through online banking. Their intelligent, cloud-based, small business accounting platform that automatically integrates bank accounts with financial tools that speed cash flow, reconcile accounts, and accelerate growth. Their mission is to create the perfect union of banking strength and accounting smarts, helping power small businesses into the future.

Babel Health provides an innovative approach to the entire risk adjustment and encounter submission process for health plans. The company’s integrated SaaS transactional and data management platform provides health plans with full transparency and control of the underlying data for business insight and critical day-to-day business decision making across all lines of business. Unlike other solutions in the marketplace, Babel enables its customer to take control of an extraordinarily complex process and provides user-friendly access to the data in order to solve the business problems inherent to risk adjustment submissions.

BitArmor is the maker of DataControl™, powerful new software that provides a faster, easier, more cost-effective way to protect and manage sensitive data throughout any organization. Unlike traditional solutions that only deal with information at specific points in the system, BitArmor DataControl software attaches a Smart Tag™ directly to the data itself — a tag that travels with the data and allows you to secure, track, and control it regardless of where it is stored or sent. BitArmor helps companies protect valuable data assets, achieve regulatory compliance, and manage data throughout its functional lifecycle.
BodyMedia, Inc. develops wearable, fashionable body monitors that record and transmit a variety of physiological data to the company’s website.
long_description: When consumers enter BodyMedia’s secure site, their personal physiological data is displayed in an extremely user-friendly format, enabling them to set, track and meet their health goals.BodyMedia will market and sell both body monitoring products and subscriptions to the website directly to consumers. However, BodyMedia will derive the majority of its revenue from business-to-business partnerships by building co-branded and/or private-labeled consumer products and Internet services for industries such as: fitness centers, .com health portals, sportswear, weight loss, employee wellness programs, healthcare monitoring, consumer electronics, etc.www.bodymedia.com

description: CardioInsight is a medical device company commercializing patented electrocardiographic imaging technology developed at Case Western Reserve University.
long_description: This technology non-invasively images electrical activity on the surface of the heart. Patented algorithms are used to combine body surface electrical data and chest CT scans to generate maps of the electrical activity of the heart during each heart beat. Proof of concept has been demonstrated in animal studies and preliminary human studies. The CardioInsight system provides more information than electrocardiograms and, unlike electrophysiology (catheter) mapping, is non-invasive. The technology has wide application in the diagnosis of electrical abnormalities during various cardiac diseases and guiding appropriate therapy.

description: Carnegie Learning is the developer of the Cognitive Tutor® comprehensive curricula for secondary mathematics. Established in 1998 by researchers, teachers and scholars from Carnegie Mellon University, Carnegie Learning was founded to apply and extend more than 20 years of award-winning research in cognitive science to mathematics instruction. Headquarterd in Pittsburgh, PA, Carnegie Learning’s mathematics courses now serve more than 150,000 students in 46 of the nation’s largest school districts, including Austin, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Miami-Dade, New York City, Pittsburgh, San Diego, San Francisco and the Department of Defense. Available courses currently include Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra II, Integrated Math and Quantitative Literacy Through Algebra.

ClubCom is a pioneer and leader in the field of constructing and operating private television networks for targeted communal audiences. ClubCom specializes in providing customized audio/video entertainment and proprietary advertising programs to commercial health clubs. ActiveMedia’s networks service some of the largest health club organizations in the world including Gold’s Gym International (“The Gold’s Gym Broadcasting Network”), with 550 locations and over 2 million members, and PowerHouse Gym’s International (“The PowerHouse Broadcasting Network”) with 300 facilities and 1.3 million members.ClubCom also provides network services to a host of regional health club organizations and even single club operations throughout the United States and Canada.
exit_note: Acquired by Precor in January of 2004.

description: Hybrid-Cloud PaaS and Continuous Delivery System for Containers
long_description: Containership makes web infrastructure completely portable – allowing developers to easily deploy code and migrate between hosting providers. With over 25 one-click install integrations, including distributed databases, queues, messaging systems, blogging software, monitoring solutions, and more.

description: Property Management Simplified
long_description: Ikos simplifies property management. Their platforms help landlords market, show, screen tenants, lease and manage their properties saving both time and money.

description: OnShift is the leading provider of staff scheduling and shift management software for the healthcare industry.
long_description: OnShift is the first to offer a SaaS-based labor cost management solution that combines communications technologies with a scheduling application to automate the resolution of staffing emergencies and prevent overtime.With OnShift, healthcare providers reduce labor costs by controlling overtime, mitigate regulatory compliance risk, and increase efficiencies through automated scheduling and open shift management. This saves time and frees up nurses to do what they do best – deliver quality resident care. Customers choose OnShift because the software is easy-to-use and fast to implement, and with it organizations experience immediate ROI.OnShift is based in Cleveland, Ohio, and was named the best emerging company by the Northeast Ohio Software Association in 2010.

description: Pixel Velocity builds imagery and data analytic tools that protect their customer’s safety, security and environment from intentional, accidental and natural threats.
long_description: Whether it’s maintaining safety or improving operational efficiency, Pixel Velocity’s products enable rapid and informed decision-making.From leak, spill and activity detection to situational awareness and response, Pixel Velocity provides configurable software solutions and sensor systems for the most demanding operational environments. Through its world-class team of subject matter experts and field-proven solutions, Pixel Velocity has an unparalleled understanding of how to empower enterprises to leverage imagery and data to manage risk.

description: RE2, Inc. is a leading developer of Intelligent Modular Manipulation Systems.
long_description: RE2 Robotics is developing the next generation of mobile robotics technologies that enable your robot to better interact with the world. RE2’s research efforts focus on creating interoperable manipulation systems with human-like performance, intuitive human robot interfaces, and advanced autonomy software for mobile robotics.

description: Renal Solutions is committed to enhancing the quality of life, improving the health and reducing the cost of care for renal failure patients by developing revolutionary products and delivering superior service.
Rhiza is an emerging leader in the field of marketing analytics, offering online tools that make Big Data actionable for marketers and salespeople.
long_description: Rhiza’s tools increase revenue for both media companies and advertisers by delivering detailed recommendations based on integrated consumer insights. Media publishers use Rhiza to arm their salespeople with better tools for selling premium advertising. Marketers use Rhiza to optimize hyper-targeted media buys, track campaign effectiveness and quickly create new marketing plans.

description: ThinkVine is a strategic marketing solutions provider, with expertise in marketing science and decision support software.
long_description: Our work provides a much needed bridge between traditional marketing research, economic modeling and statistical analysis. From marketing models and pricing research, to the creation of agent based modeling tools that simulate the complexity of consumer behavior, ThinkVine solutions can help you make more informed and effective business decisions.

description: TOA Technologies developed an innovative software solutions that streamline the mobile work environment and enhance communications between companies and their customers.
long_description: TOA Technologies was founded by two Israeli immigrants, Yuval Brisker and Irad Carmi, in Beachwood Ohio. Brisker, an architect, and Carmi, a classical musician, designed a platform that would become the leading cloud-based field service solution to manage and optimize the last mile of customer service for enterprises, by coordinating activities between dispatchers, mobile employees and their customers. In 2005 Draper Triangle led TOA’s Series A financing and participated in subsequent financing rounds led by Intel Capital in 2008 and Sutter Hill Ventures in 2011. In 2013, Technology Crossover Ventures invested $66 million in a Series E financing. The Company grew to nearly 600 employees with customers in 30 countries. In September, 2014 Oracle acquired TOA in what was believed to be the largest acquisition ever of an Ohio-based technology Company. Draper Triangle partner, Mike Stubler , led the deal and was a member of the Board from Draper Triangle’s initial investment to the acquisition by Oracle.
